Will anything be sent without my approval?

No. Every agent and automation has a review gate before the consequential step: sending a message, changing a record, publishing, or charging. The draft or queued action waits in your inbox for you to approve, edit, or reject.
Can you work with the tools I already use?
Yes. We connect to your existing mailboxes, CRM, forms, and invoicing through their supported APIs. Access, permissions, and data quality are checked before anything syncs.
What if I only want one thing automated?
That is the usual start. We take the job that costs you the most time, get it running with its approval gate, and add the next one only if you want it.
How do I know what it will cost?
After a discovery call you receive a written proposal with scope, what each part needs from you, and terms. No payment is required to inquire.
The handoff includes documentation, a walkthrough of the review inbox and pause switch, and fourteen days of fixes and adjustments. Ongoing maintenance can be arranged separately.
